name: Hotel Restaurant Pizzeria Haid
beschreibung: Hotel Restaurant Pizzeria Haid is situated in St. Leonhard im Pitztal at approximately 1,400 metres elevation in the heart of Tyrol's scenic Pitztal Valley. It provides an exceptional base for exploring the Pitztal Glacier and Rifflsee ski domains in winter, alongside extensive high-altitude hiking trails in summer. The property features comfortable alpine rooms and a popular restaurant serving freshly baked pizzas and traditional Tyrolean specialties.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Restaurant Pizzeria Haid in St. Leonhard in the Pitztal valley offers cozy rooms, an authentic pizzeria and Tyrolean dining, and easy access to the Pitztal Glacier.
